label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read instantly as a sword at 64 px (pointed blade, wide flared guard, round pommel); top view is the expected thin bar with guard and gems visible, centred.
evidence.V2: Clear big/medium/small: blade slab dominates, guard and pommel are the medium masses, gem, grip bands and fuller are the small detail.
evidence.V3: Chunky stylised read, but the blade is a constant-width parallel slab with a short stubby tip and a flat bar guard: partly exaggerated, partly stiff primitive.
evidence.V4: Guard and grip bands carry chamfers that catch light (bright edge line on the guard in the close-up), but the blade edges and tip are hard planar facets with no visible bevel, and the pommel is an unbevelled low-segment sphere: inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Correctness passes (front outline symmetric, A15 X/Y 0.0, alignment 0.0, all seats seated), but the pommel close-up shows a visibly polygonal sphere outline and the fuller shows a dark smeared shading blotch mid-blade in front and blade_mid studio renders that is absent in the flat render: minor artifacts, capped at 1.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent (guard, pommel, bands), two steel greys (blade face, darker fuller) and one hue (teal grip wrap and gem); colourways swap only the hue cleanly (crimson, shadow).
evidence.V7: 2,220 tris vs weapon target 2,500 (ceiling 4,000): at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and kit palette match, but blade lacks the ~0.045-stud chamfer and smooth-shaded look seen on the guard, and the pommel sphere faceting is coarser than the rest: minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle, origin at grip point, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pommel sphere has a visibly faceted/polygonal outline in the pommel studio close-up (too few segments for its screen size).
Fuller shows a dark smeared gradient blotch mid-blade in the front and blade_mid studio renders (shading interpolation across long thin faces; flat render is uniform).
Blade edges and tip are razor-hard planar facets with no chamfer, unlike the chamfered guard and bands.
Guard flat render outline has small kinks along the arm edges where chamfer segments meet (minor).
top_fixes: Give the blade a profile: slight taper from guard to tip and a longer, more confident point (or a subtle flare at the ricasso) so it stops reading as a parallel slab.
Add a consistent ~0.045-stud chamfer to the blade edges and tip so edge treatment matches the guard and catches light.
Raise the pommel sphere segment count (or add a chamfered collar transition) to remove the polygonal outline; 280 tris of headroom under target covers it.
Fix the fuller shading smear with support loops or split/weighted normals along the fuller walls so the groove shades as a clean uniform band.
Minor: lengthen the grip slightly and enlarge the guard gem so the small-detail tier reads at distance.
